title: Willamette Valley Wine Tour - Full Day Tour
includes: Pickup and drop-off from designated meeting points
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age is 21 years to drink Alcohol
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Discover Oregon's world famous wine region known as Willamette Valley and experience the best pinot noir, chardonnay, rose and other varietals guided by local wine lovers on this 8 hour tour. An excellent trip for new and seasoned wine lovers, a romantic weekend, or last minute vacation with your friends. Gain an inside perspective about the growing region, the winemaking process and the history of this valley. Expect to be pampered, entertained, and truly have a memorable trip in Oregon's Wine Country. This is a joinable small group tour for 2 persons or more. We will explore 3 of the finest vineyards in the valley and do a sit down lunch at our favorite establishment or vineyard lunch pairing. Proceed to check availability to see your exact price for the group size, we will handle all route planning and reservations on your behalf and offer door to door pickup and dropoff.
